description: Exploit the margin and measure the epoch slope on the current recipe. On E018, change only the epoch count, from 9.5 to 9.25 (32 steps/epoch at batch 1536 with drop_last, so 296 steps instead of 304), with the LR schedule stretched to match. Nothing else changes. The result gives the pp-per-second exchange rate on the graphed batch-1536 net, the reference for scoring every later per-step cut.
